title: Mixed moments of arithmetic functions and Kloosterman sums
summary: We extend the Nair--Tenenbaum estimates for short sums of nonnegative arithmetic functions at polynomial values to mixed moments involving Kloosterman sums. Combining these estimates with lower bounds obtained by refining the method of Fouvry and Michel, we prove that, for every fixed nonzero integer \(a\) and fixed \(z,ν>0\), \[ \sum_{n\leq x}z^{ω(n)} |\operatorname{Kl}(a;n)|^ν\asymp_{a,z,ν} x(\log x)^{z\mathfrak{s}(ν)-1}, \] where \(ω(n)\) counts distinct prime divisors and \(\mathfrak{s}(ν)\) is the \(ν\)-th absolute moment of the Sato--Tate measure.
